readerCopy.body: Being good at the old role can make it harder to admit that you are finished with it. The Sun square the South Node can put your identity up against a habit of proving yourself in the same familiar way. A title, audience, responsibility, or kind of recognition may keep asking for the version of you that knows exactly how to deliver. The friction matters because competence can hide exhaustion. Notice what you keep doing because it confirms who you used to be, not because it still deserves your time.
